prd.title: Submit Report Page (Anjali / citizen)
prd.overview: The Submit Report Page is Anjali's web-form surface for reporting a water-safety concern. Bangla-first default. Plain-language category picker (NOT T1/T2/T3). Photo capture with auto-EXIF. Reporter-badge = anchor (verified NID → anchor). Trust band defaults to T1 (unverified, NOT T3). 5-min dual-channel ack (SMS + portal). Closes MAJOR #1 of the 5 MAJOR items. Tier 3 (light) but load-bearing for anchor citizen flow.

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/SubmitReportPage.tsx (350 LOC); emit IncidentCreated{reporter_kind: anchor, band: T1}; MAJOR #1 fix: plain-language category

requirement.title: Mount route at /submit for citizen
requirement.description: Register route in App.tsx wrapped in RequireSession with role guard for citizen. Remove /submit from ComingSoonPage mapping per WO-016.

requirement.title: MAJOR #1: Plain-language category picker (no T1/T2/T3)
requirement.description: Category picker uses plain-language categories (e.g., "Discoloured water", "Bad smell", "Low pressure", "No supply"). NO T1/T2/T3 technical categories on this surface. Closes MAJOR #1 from 02-phase-4-closeout.md §4.3.

acceptance.criterion: Category options are plain-language (no T1/T2/T3 strings)
grep 'T1\|T2\|T3' in category dropdown options returns zero hits

requirement.title: Bangla-first default locale
requirement.description: On first visit, locale = 'bn'. Operator toggle EN ↔ BN; preference persists in IDB. Bangla numerals for all timestamps via Intl.NumberFormat('bn-BD').

acceptance.criterion: Timestamp numerals render in Bangla script

requirement.title: Location (auto-detect + editable + manual)
requirement.description: Location control: lat/lon auto-detect via navigator.geolocation (with permission), each field editable, OR manual address string fallback.

acceptance.criterion: Manual address fallback works when geolocation denied

requirement.title: Description (500 char limit)
requirement.description: Description textarea enforces 500 char limit with running char counter. Bangla numerals for time fields throughout.

requirement.title: Photo capture with auto-EXIF
requirement.description: Photo capture control (camera or gallery). After selection, auto-populate EXIF strip (lat/lon/timestamp/device). All EXIF fields editable.

requirement.title: Submit emits IncidentCreated (anchor + T1)
requirement.description: On submit, emit POST /api/events with IncidentCreated{reporter_kind: anchor, band: T1, description, location, photo_hash, hotline_call_id: null}. Per lockdown, citizen NEVER gets T3 default.

acceptance.criterion: Submit emits IncidentCreated with band=T1 (NOT T2/T3)

requirement.title: 5-min dual-channel ack (SMS + portal notice)
requirement.description: After submission, render success page with incident ID + "View your report" link to /my-reports/:incident_id/timeline. Ack surfaces via SMS (mock) + portal notice within 5 minutes (real time). Per Scenario 03 Screen 2.

acceptance.criterion: Success page renders with incident ID

requirement.title: MAJOR #1 reconciliation: no T1/T2/T3 on this surface
requirement.description: Verify category options are plain-language; verify default band = T1 (not T3); verify no Hindi strings; verify anchor reporter-badge (not hotline/webform).

acceptance.criterion: grep 'T1\|T2\|T3' in user-facing strings returns zero hits
grep 'hi' locale returns zero hits in this component

requirement.title: i18n keys (EN + BN)
requirement.description: Add i18n keys for plain-language categories, ack messaging, success page, button labels. EN + BN parity. No Hindi.

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: submit-report-page, …-header, …-main, …-category-picker, …-location, …-description, …-photo-capture, …-exif-strip, …-button-submit, …-success, …-view-report-link.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Open category picker; assert options are plain-language; grep for T1/T2/T3 in option strings returns zero. Plain-language categories; no technical band names.
Clear IDB; mount; assert locale=bn. Toggle to en; reload; assert en persists. Bangla-first default; persistence works.
Fill form; submit; intercept POST /api/events; assert IncidentCreated with reporter_kind=anchor and band=T1. Event payload correct.
Submit successfully; assert success page renders with incident ID + link. Success page works.
